senses.gloss: m. (preced.) [that which is pulled out,] stubble field.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:29">Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 29</cite> <he>אינו … נירה למניחה לפניו ש׳</he> it is not the same when he surrenders the land tilled (cleared), as when he surrenders it with the stubbles.—Pl. <cite ref="U01360"><he>שְׁלָפִים</he></cite>.
Cant. R. to VI, 12 מלקטת בש׳ picked up (ears) among the stubbles.—Trnsf. constr. שִׁלְפֵי, שִׁי׳ the end of a period.
<cite ref="Yevamot 116b:10">Yeb. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ קציר חטים היו</he> it was towards the end of the wheat harvest.

<cite ref="Shabbat 60a:9">Sabb. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ הגזירה היו</he> (Ar. <cite ref="E00927"><he>השמד</he></cite>; Ms. M. <he>שליפי</he>, corr. acc.; Ms. O. <cite ref="U01224"><he>שלהי</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) it was the end of the period of persecution; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite> <he>בש׳ השמד</he>.
